name: Samvel Karapetyan
current_role: Founder/president, Tashir Group (Russia/Armenia); leader of Armenia's 'Strong Armenia' party
profile: Armenian-born developer who moved to Russia in the 1990s, ran Kaluga supplier Kalugaglavsnab (a Gazprom subcontractor) and founded Tashir Group in 1999 - shopping centers, Moscow construction, and Electric Networks of Armenia. In 2026 he was Strong Armenia's PM candidate while under house arrest in Armenia.
interesting_fact: Tashir Group owns Electric Networks of Armenia, the country's power distributor, and in 2021 he announced plans to invest about $600M in Armenia's energy sector.
deep_cut_fact: He trained as an engineer: he graduated from the mechanical engineering faculty of Yerevan Polytechnic Institute in 1986. Through the Tashir Charitable Foundation (2000) he paid ~$2M toward the Vardenis-Martakert highway in 2013.
notes: Politically exposed: detained mid-2025 in Armenia, then under house arrest during 2026 (charges disputed; extended July 2026 per ARKA). He said he would not return to Russia. Route via Tashir press service; outreach may be sensitive. Forbes says his hometown Kalinino was renamed Tashir.
